# {{PRODUCT}} planning repository

> Product planning only. Not the FE/BE implementation repositories.

## Start here

- [Entry requirements (activation)](my-project-requirements.md): if this root file exists, the agent runs playbook planning automatically (`software-factory-all-in-one/00-USAGE.md`)
- [Agent start (any AI)](docs/AGENT_START.md): hard rails, map, checks
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): full mandatory rules for every coding agent
- [Delivery method](docs/DELIVERY.md): actor loop; no MVP delivery mode
- [Requirements](requirements.md): formal product source of truth (derived from the entry file when present)
- [README](README.md): public summary

## Verify before claiming done

- `node scripts/check-delivery.mjs`
- `node scripts/check-agents.mjs`
- `node scripts/check-scope.mjs`

## Optional discovery files

Harness-specific pointers all defer to AGENTS.md: CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, .codex/, .cursor/rules/, .github/copilot-instructions.md, .windsurf/rules/.
